cards.title: Recovery and waiting
items: After recover reconstructs a complete original result, read status again. Recovery does not resend the letter.
For run-busy, save the new draft and wait. One run permits only one active exchange.

cards.title: Continuity and deadlines
items: auto uses the native session from previous_exchange_id; failure does not silently replay history.
run-open sets the prompt deadline; outer grace is 15 seconds, cancel grace 10. Timeout cannot guarantee remote stop.
